items.name: Hand Crossbow
items.description: Sometimes referred to as an alley bow by rogues or ruffians, this small crossbow fires small bolts that are sometimes used to deliver poison to the target. It's small enough to be shot one-handed, but it still requires two hands to load.

items.name: Rapier
items.description: The rapier is a long and thin piercing blade with a basket hilt. It is prized among many as a dueling weapon.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

defensiveAbilities.name: Nimble Dodge
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The blade assassin is targeted with a melee or ranged attack by an attacker they can see

Effect The blade assassin gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack

defensiveAbilities.name: Otherworldly Will
defensiveAbilities.description: The blade assassin is driven forward by a singular, otherworldly will, guiding their actions. Whenever the blade assassin attempts a Will saving throw against a mental effect that would control or dictate their actions, the blade assassin treats the result of the saving throw as one category better.

defensiveAbilities.name: Unexplained Demise
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The assassin is captured alive

Effect Blood pours from the assassin's ears and nose, and they drop dead on the spot. An adjacent PC who witnesses this unexplained death must succeed at a DC 22 Will Saving Throw save or become Frightened 1.

offensiveAbilities.name: Poison Weapon
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The blade assassin is wielding a piercing or slashing weapon and has a free hand

Effect The blade assassin applies a poison to the weapon.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: The blade assassin deals an extra 2d6 precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.

offensiveAbilities.name: Surprise Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: On the first round of combat, creatures that haven't acted yet are Off-Guard to the blade assassin.
